card.name: Partway through oncology and treatment terms
card.fires_on: Mostly the ending 'us' of 'bolus' in 5-FU chemotherapy regimens, and some other mid-phrase words in treatment descriptions such as 'neoadjuvant', 'Maintenance Treatment', and 'infusion system'.

modes.label: Bolus in 5-FU regimens
modes.description: The 'us' that completes 'bolus' before 5-FU in chemotherapy dosing text.

modes.label: Other treatment-phrase words
modes.description: A noun or word part inside a treatment phrase, such as neoadjuvant or infusion system.

card.plain: It lights up on the end of 'bolus' in chemotherapy regimens and a few other treatment-related words.
